about: What a reward casket gives, tier by tier, as the OSRS Wiki's Reward casket pages list it (Standard tables, read 2026-11-19; rates confirmed by Mod Tide, 24 May 2019). Opening one rolls the tier's table rolls.min to rolls.max times: each line is weight out of slots, the Wiki's per-roll rarity exactly (its nested tables multiplied out, so every unique, mega-rare and shared line is one line here). A line's with items come beside it (the hard mega-rare's three super potions). extra lines are rolled once a casket besides the rolls (the master scroll box isn't one: TreasureTrails.masterBox rolls it under the master cap, exploit review R55B-1); milestones come with the casket that makes the tier's count. The Mimic's own table (elite and master) waits for the Mimic; the Bloodhound pet waits for pets, and the emote milestones (Explore, Uri transform) for emotes. Items are ids with their cache names beside them; the loader warns when a name doesn't match. Generated from the Wiki's tables by the Treasure Trails thread's script, not typed.
